Welcome to Kanji Scanner!

This quick tutorial will guide you through the app’s features.

This is the Home Screen. Wait for the download progress bar to finish. Once it’s complete, you can search for kanji and mark or unmark them as learned.
Please wait until the kanji download is complete before marking a kanji as learned.
Camera permission is required to scan kanji.

Image Scanner

Use this screen to scan kanji from images.

Tap the image card to select a picture from your device. After scanning, recognized kanji appear below. Tap a kanji for actions or long press it to copy.

Scan

Use your camera to identify kanji. Tap a kanji to get details using Google AI.

Tap the bottom-right button to pause the scan.

Stylized kanji, decorative fonts, or image quality can make identification more difficult.
Tap a kanji for details. Pause the camera to review results.

Explore all Jōyō kanji with meanings and readings.
Use the search bar. Tap a kanji to get details via Google AI or copy it to the clipboard. Finally, use the check icon to mark it as learned.
Recognize kanji in real-time using your camera.
Point the camera to Japanese text, tap a detected kanji for options (Stylized kanji or decorative fonts can make identification more difficult).
Recognize kanji from an image in your gallery.
Open the image scan button in the scan screen, select a photo and review extracted kanji (Stylized kanji, decorative fonts or image quality can make identification more difficult).
Track all kanji you already learned.
Open Learned tab, check your progress bar, tap a kanji for details, and remove it when needed.
Back up your learned kanji progress or restore it on this device.
Open the top-right menu and select Import / Export. Tap Export JSON to save a learned-kanji.json backup, or Import JSON to restore one. Imported kanji are merged with your current learned list.
